duplicate_screen.method: Searched discovery and source files and leads for Antikythera, gears, Saros, Metonic, Hipparchus and Babylonian astronomy; inspected matching records and all events.
duplicate_screen.result: Existing gearing record has one dated archaeological event, already documenting construction but not the detailed surviving eclipse scale. Existing Babylonian astronomy record covers broad observation, predictive schemes and a general Greek transmission event. The open geared-astronomy lead was not modified; extension avoids a duplicate discovery.
